name: My Stepsister - A Short Story
source:
Based on true events, this short little VN is about a romance and sexual encounter between teenage stepsiblings.
"Lucy" was a very petite girl of Vietnamese origin who frequently wore her hair in sexy braids and liked to watch TV in her underwear. This is the story about how we confessed our true feelings for each other and became lovers.

[From F95zone]
translation:
